title: Deploy from GitHub
description: Deploy web apps directly from GitHub to AWS Amplify with auto-updates.
fulldescription: This prototype connects your GitHub repository to AWS Amplify to automatically build and deploy your web application. It sets up a continuous deployment pipeline, so changes pushed to your code are instantly reflected on your live site. It uses AWS Lambda to trigger the initial deployment and manages the build configuration for modern web frameworks like React or Vue. This is perfect for hosting projects exported from AI coding tools or standard web repositories.

services.name: AWS Amplify
services.desc: Hosts the web application and manages the build pipeline.

services.name: Lambda
services.desc: Triggers the initial build and handles custom deployment logic.

services.name: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)
services.desc: Securely manages permissions for the build services.
